date_scope_check.qualification_retained: The October 4, 2024 strike severed through-vehicle access at the Masnaa road; pedestrians continued crossing. The former October 10 last-confirmation and six-day minimum are withdrawn because reproduced evidence did not support them. A November 30 ministerial statement reported the road repaired and operational, providing a later restoration bound. Exact first restoration and intervening continuity remain unresolved; later strikes are separate events. No continuous October–November closure or exact duration is inferred.
